messages:
maya: SableCore joint perf kickoff — partner asked for a compact reproducible protocol for marketplace certification. Need perf/W, throughput, and kernel tuning notes. @oscar @li can you propose a minimal sweep?
oscar: Minimal sweep: model=llama-7b + llama-13b, seq=1024/2048, powercaps=90/130/170W, quants=q4_0,q8_0. Capture p50/p95/p99, throughput_tps, and power sampled at 5Hz. Include per-token energy metric.
li: Kernel knobs: isolcpus=2-9 nohz_full=2-9 rcu_nocbs=2-9 amd_pstate=passive. Add example run: ./bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant q4_0 --powercap 130 --out s3://redwood-bench/sablecore/1748888888/
maya: Partner requested acceptance criteria: perf/W >= baseline+12% at 130W OR p99 < 220ms at seq=2048. They want a one-page summary and raw CSVs.
oscar: I'll author the runbook and CSV schema. Example CSV header: [run_id,model,seq,powercap,quant,batch,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tps,avg_power_w,perf_per_w].
li: Dataset: 600 curated prompts at /data/bench/sablecore/600.jsonl.gz. I'll stage and checksum. Ops: please calibrate rack power meters before the run.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-9001 created, label=sablecore-marketplace. Tag experiments with "sablecore-2026-mar". Bench slot tentatively Thu 14:00-16:00 PT.
maya: Action items: Oscar -> runbook + CSV; Li -> dataset + pmu scripts; I'll draft one-pager and schedule partner sync Fri 11am PT. If no blockers, proceed with smoke tomorrow.
oscar: Ack. Will include Grafana links in runbook.
li: Ack. Will do smoke and upload artifacts to s3.
maya: Thanks team. I'll loop in SableCore contact after smoke. :thumbsup:
